tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅: u rgyan pad+ma'i sgrub pa gnyen po stobs kyi sgrub pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so:

rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas la phyag 'tshal lo: rig 'dzin dbang sdud kyi sgrub pa 'di la gnas dang: rdzas: sgrub pa'o: dang po gnas ni dben par bya: rdzas ni: 'bru sna'i gtor ma: dkar gsum dang: mngar gsum chang gis sbrus te: rin chen 'bar ba'i dbyibs la: rtse mo nyi zlas brgyan pa: phyi rim pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i bskor ba bya: gzhan yang mchod pa dang spyan gzigs mang po bshams: dbang phyug dang sbrags na de'i rten dang: rdzas rnams kyang bshams: khyad par slob dpon pad+ma'i bris sku bkram la de nas bsgrub pa la 'jug ste: dang po stong pa'i ngang las: paṃ las pad+ma'i sdong po gcig bsam: de'i steng du hrīḥyig dmar pos mtshan pa las 'od 'phros: de zhu ba las 'od kyi thig le dmar por gyur: de las gu ru pad+ma 'byung gnas sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: spyan rtsa dmar zhing 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang ldan pa: dbu la sha ba'i mnyen zhu dang: sku la dar gyi ber dmar gsol ba: phyag gnyis dbang sdud kyi phyag rgya bcas nas: nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa gcig bsgom: de'i thugs ka'i hrīḥdamar po las 'od zer lcags kyu lta bu 'phros pas: bar snang thams cad dmar lam lam khengs te: stong gsum 'jig rten thams cad dbang du sdud par bsam mo: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma pā shaṃ ku ru ye dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: a bhi ṣiñtsa maṃ: zhes brjod pas: gu ru pad+ma lho nub mtshams nas spyan drangs te: sku la gnyis med du thim par bsam mo: de nas gu ru rang gi spyi gtsug tu byon nas: 'od du lam zhu bar bsam: de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni: mos gus dung byas te: 'di skad brjod do: hūm̐: bstan pa 'di la ngo mtshar rmad byung ba'i: 'jig rten dbang bsgyur pad+ma rgyal po ni: rigs ni o rgyan rgyal po'i sras su 'khrungs: za hor yul du sgro 'dogs ma lus bcad: bsil ma tshal du dngos grub rnam gnyis thob: wa rā ṇa sir chos kyi 'khor lo bskor:

'jig rten khams su gdug pa can rnams btul: kha ba can du bstan pa rgyas par mdzad: lho nub mtshams su srin po'i kha gnon mdzad: sku gsum dbyer med che mchog he ru ka: mya ngan mi 'da' 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig po: mnyam med bla ma mchog de dus 'dir dran: 'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: dbang gi las tshogs 'grub par mdzad du gsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma ba liṃ ta khā hi: a mṛta khā hi: dhū pe dhū: puṣ+pe hūm̐: ā lo ke hrī: ghan+dhe ghan: gīrtī ho: nirtī hrī: pū dza khā hi: zhes gtor ma dang mchod pa 'bul: khyed la mchod cing gsol ba btab pa'i mthus: bdag sogs gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs 'dir: longs spyod rin chen sna tshogs char 'beb cing: bsam don yid bzhin 'grub pa'i dngos grub stsol: ces zhu 'o: de nas gu ru pad+ma gong ltar sgom: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma pā shaṃ ku ru rat+na sid+dhi dza dza: zhes zhag bdun bzla 'o: zas nor mang po ster ba'am: rnyed pa rmi ba'am 'byung ngo: sgrub pa'i khongs su zas nor steng ba byung na rtags mi 'gyur ba yin: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: de nas rang khams gsum dbang sdud: 'khor mkha' 'gro dang bcas par gsal ba'i spyi bor gu ru pad+ma bsgoms la: dbang phyug mkha' 'gro dang bcas pa'i snying po 'di: nyi shu rtsa gcig bzlas na: 'jig rten khams thams cad dbang du 'du 'o: gnyen po stobs kyi sgrub pa rdzogs so: ྈྈྈ ྈྈྈ 'di la shog ser dmar po dkyus mdzub gang: zheng sor drug 'dug pa las zhal bshus so: nub zangs mdzod nas rig 'dzin chen po dngos grub rgyal mtshan gyis spyan drangs pa yin no: : 1$0000250༄༅: dbang sdud las kyi 'khor lo'i rtags kyi drod tshad bstan pa ni:1$0000300 phyi nang gsang ba'i rim pa sgrubs: rmi lam rtags ni sna tshogs 'ong: rta dang ma he mdzo dang g.yag: ba lang sha ba gcan gzan dang: dar 'phyar dung 'bud khrom tshogs dang:

gyen la 'dzegs dang chu chen bskyil: gcig tu ma nges sna tshogs pa: bsnyen pa'i rtags su shes par bya: lho bal mon dang a tsa ra: skad rigs mi mthun pa rnams kyis: zas sna mang po ster ba dang: dge bshes che btsun ches mang gis: bdag la snyan pa sgrog pa dang: skyes pa bud med mdzes pa yis: bdag la zas skom ster ba dang: ro bshas sha chen zos pa dang: zung ngas sdud dang lci ba 'thu: btsas brnga g.yul byed longs spyod sogs: 'od dang sgra dang tsha lam dang: 'jigs skrag dngangs pa'i cho 'phrul 'ong: sgrub pa'i rtags su shes par bya: de nas las sbyor byas pa yis: bdag la sngon bas bkur sti che: phyag 'tshal chos 'bul zas nor 'bul: sgra gcod rta dang g.yu gos 'bul: phyi sgrub zhag bdun byas pa'i rtags: grags pa'i gtam dang snyan pa'i sgra: sgra dang cho 'phrul 'ong bar 'gyur: rtags de ma byung zhag bdun bsring: nang sgrub zhag bdun byas pa'i rtags: zas nor longs spyod 'bul ba dang: rang gi bu lon bskyal ba 'ong: gsang sgrub zhag bdun byas pa'i rtags: dge bshes che btsun mi dmangs kyis: dga' tshul gus gtam gtong ba 'ong: rtags byung bar du yun bsring sgrubs: sems kyi the tshom rab tu spang: gus pas brtson 'grub bskyed la sgrubs: de rnams spyi yi rtags tshad yin: rdo rje spre chung sems la chongs: phyi rabs las can pad+ma'i rigs: skal ba can dang 'phrad par shog: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: ྈྈྈྈྈྈ byang zang zang lha brag gi nub zangs mdzod dmar po nas rig 'dzin rgod kyi ldem 'phru can gyis spyan drangs pa'o: bkra shis/ dge'o// dge'o// dge'o/// / ༈ dpe tshan 'di sngon chad gter mdzod dkyus su med cing*/ bal yul zhe dgon gyi par gsar 'dir gsar bzhag byas pas lung rgyun la zhib rtog dgos pa yin no//
